gold.question: A contract covered by the original text of Directive (EU) 2019/770 does not say when the trader will supply a digital service. When must the trader supply it?
gold.reference_answer: Unless the parties have agreed otherwise, the trader must supply the digital content or digital service without undue delay after the conclusion of the contract.
key_facts: 1. The trader shall supply the digital content or digital service to the consumer. Unless the parties have agreed otherwise, the trader shall supply the digital content or digital service without undue delay after the conclusion of the contract.
